PC-GEN-024.question: An insurer incorporated in Canada and licensed to do business in New Jersey is classified in New Jersey as a(n):
PC-GEN-024.explanation: Under N.J.S.A. 17B:17-7, an alien insurer is formed under the laws of another country. A foreign insurer is formed in another US state, and a domestic insurer is formed in New Jersey.

PC-AUTO-015.explanation: UM pays bodily injury damages the insured is legally entitled to recover from an at-fault driver who has no liability insurance or cannot be identified. New Jersey policies also include UM property damage (not for hit-and-run vehicles, and subject to a $500 exclusion) under N.J.S.A. 17:28-1.1, but many states do not require it, and UM never pays the uninsured driver's own bills.
